title: a16z Podcast: AMPLab, the Power of Open Source, and the Future of Systems Software

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: The place where Apache Spark was born, UC Berkeley’s AMPLab has not just created a major open source software platform.
reader_summary.overview: The place where Apache Spark was born, UC Berkeley’s AMPLab has not just created a major open source software platform. How has open source and the AMPLab approach reduced the friction between student and faculty ideas and launching them into the real world? Co-founder and director of the AMPLab, Michael Franklin, joins a16z’s Peter Levine to discuss the AMPLab model.

key_points.text: The place where Apache Spark was born, UC Berkeley’s AMPLab has not just created a major open source software platform.
Co-founder and director of the AMPLab, Michael Franklin, joins a16z’s Peter Levine to discuss the AMPLab model.
Haoyuan Li also joins the discussion -- which was part of our 2015 Academic Roundtable -- to offer another perspective.
